reviews.author: Alexander Kazakov
reviews.text:
I was planning to get a few facials there, but after the consultation the total amount offered was around 2.904 million watts (about 1812 euros).

After receiving the so-called "free consultation", I left the room and was consulted about the "price". I was told to come back to the room in 15-20 minutes.

After I told them the price, I said I would reconsider. In the end, we charged 20,000 watts per person as a consultation fee. When I questioned it, they said that if I decided to continue using the service, they would deduct the amount from my final bill. But I wasn't told that before I scheduled my "free consultation". It was false advertising, especially since it said "free consultation" on my email confirmation, which was a red flag.

It would be nice to compare elsewhere, but honestly, this isn't great. It seems like they are manipulating the prices for foreigners. It felt like a scam.

I've been coming here for eyeliner and eyebrow retouching for several years now (my eyebrows are thin but in great shape). I'm really bad at drawing eyebrows and I'm really lazy. My eyeliner melted all over my face, an experience I never want to have again after interviewing a raccoon. So I chose permanent makeup. The employees don't speak English, but they speak basic Korean and have good skills, so you can trust them. The eyebrows look so dark and scary for the first few days (like Groucho Marks). But over time, it naturally changes naturally. It's exactly what I wanted. The artist makes sure I'm completely satisfied with the shape I've drawn before taking out the eyebrow knife.

I asked for the eyeliner to be a little thicker, and although it was a bit uncomfortable, I had no choice. The first few times I got really natural eyeliner, it really tickled me.

I make a reservation through KakaoTalk. I'm really satisfied with this price because I don't have to buy pencils, gels, etc. and I can waste less time in front of the mirror. If you use this with your eyelash extensions, your skin will be clean enough to remove your makeup!

reviews.text:
Never go to this store! This is unbelievable and truly unprofessional.
A month ago, I had the watch repaired and polished, and the estimate was about 450,000 won. I called two weeks later and they said the work wasn't done yet. I contacted them again the following week and it still wasn't done. In the meantime, the store did not provide any information about the progress. They had promised to complete the watch before I returned home, but the day before I left the country, they suddenly said that the entire watch movement would need to be replaced and that the total cost would be 650,000 won. I refused and asked for my watch back, but to my surprise, they told me I would have to pay an additional 300,000 won for the work that had already been done. Plus, they said the watch still wouldn't work. When I first received the quote, they said they would only charge me 10,000 won for repair and diagnostic fees, which was obviously false.
It was a really unpleasant experience. I have used other repair shops in the past, but this is the first time I have seen such absurd and fraudulent behavior.
